title: myosotis sylvatica subsp. soleirolii
intro: Myosotis sylvatica subsp. soleirolii, commonly known as the alpine forget-me-not, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the borage family. This plant is known for its blue forget-me-not-like flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Myosotis sylvatica subsp. soleirolii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-histaminic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides.
